| TASK # | DESCRIPTION |
|---|---|
| 1 | Start music (forward arms position, with indicator and thumb fingers stretched). |
| 2 | Stop music (forward arms position, hands closed). |
| 3 | Select instruments’ groups (left hand to select/highlight instruments/voices sections, in the following order: left, right, center). |
| 4 | Binary gesture. |
| 5 | Ternary gesture. |
| 6 | Quaternary gesture. |
| 7 | Compound Binary gesture. |
| 8 | Decrease loudness (small quaternary). |
| 9 | Increase loudness (large quaternary). |
| 10 | Slow down tempo of quaternary gesture. |
| 11 | Speed up tempo of quartenary gesture. |
